public_body: Commonwealth Of Massachusetts Asian American Commission
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the public-participation claim, the September 30, 2019 executive session claims, or the minutes claim, and declined the June 16, 2020 complaint as untimely.

allegations.summary: Complainant, a commission member, alleged she was silenced and not allowed to speak at the August 25, 2020 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because it is within the Chair’s discretion to limit public participation during a meeting, she did not violate the Open Meeting Law by restricting the complainant from speaking even though the complainant is a member of the Commission.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 16, 2020 executive session under Purpose 1 was improper and denied procedural rights; filed over three months later.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, any complaint relating to the propriety of the June 16, 2020, meeting or whether the Commission failed to provide the complainant with certain procedural rights as required under Purpose 1 should have been filed within 30 days of the June 16, 2020, meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the September 30, 2019 Purpose 1 executive session notice was insufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the notice provided a sufficient description of the executive session purpose where the notice, as well as the announcement preceding the executive session, included the specific statutory citation to Purpose 1 and identified the individuals to be discussed during that executive session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Purpose 1 executive session on September 30, 2019 failed to provide the discussed individuals their procedural rights, including advance notice.
allegations.key_passage: Moreover, we find that the Commission sent an email to the Executive Committee members who were the subject of the Purpose 1 discussion on September 25, 2019, and therefore properly notified the individuals who were the subject of the executive session discussions.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the September 30, 2019 executive session discussions went beyond what Purpose 1 permits.
allegations.key_passage: Finally, after a review of the executive session minutes, we find that the discussions that occurred during the September 30, 2019, executive session were appropriate under Purpose 1 as the discussions pertained to complaints filed by Commission staff about the executive officers of the Commission.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the September 30, 2019 meeting were inaccurate, without identifying a specific deficiency.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing the minutes, we note that they contain the date, time and place of the meeting, the members present and absent, a summary of the discussions on each subject, as well as the decisions made and the actions taken at the meeting, including a record of the votes, as required by the Open Meeting Law.
